details: This package is a WhatsApp bot library, a republished fork of the Baileys client, that silently enrols every account using it into a fixed WhatsApp channel: lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules an unguarded setTimeout(..., 90000) that issues a newsletter FOLLOW query (newsletterWMexQuery with QueryIds.FOLLOW) for the hardcoded channel JID 120363400780200098@newsletter. No code path lets the host application opt out. The package also resolves two runtime dependencies (its libsignal binding and its ESLint config) from mutable git+https URLs on the publisher's own GitHub account instead of the npm registry, so installed code is not integrity-pinned by the registry. The library contains no obfuscation, no eval/atob decoding and no hidden network destinations beyond the WhatsApp endpoints it is designed to talk to; the only process execution is the ffmpeg thumbnail call in lib/Utils/messages-media.js.
